planets.name: TOI-1266 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1266 with a 18.8-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-1266 c was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-1266. Its orbit and size follow Greklek-McKeon et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
